instructions: These effect families group common gameplay concepts into simpler launcher categories.
commonFields lists the most common runtime field names that show up for that effect family.

entries.label: Health
entries.description: HP, max HP, shield, and bonus-health style values.

entries.label: Damage
entries.description: Direct damage, damage scaling, crit damage, and return-damage style values.

entries.label: Cooldown
entries.description: Cooldown timers, start cooldowns, and cooldown reduction.

entries.label: Timing
entries.description: Durations, lifetime, cast times, tick rates, and time-to-live.

entries.label: Movement
entries.description: Projectile speed, dash speed, move speed, acceleration, and travel reach.

entries.label: Size
entries.description: Gameplay-affecting scale, area, size, and radius values.

entries.label: Status Effects
entries.description: Status effect rows such as burn, poison, slow, and custom multipliers.

entries.label: Linked Effects
entries.description: Effect references that point to another passive, prefab, or behaviour.

entries.label: Presentation
entries.description: Name, description, short description, icon, and UI visibility settings.

entries.label: Pools
entries.description: Global and per-character pools for augments and items.

entries.label: Ability Swap
entries.description: Slot-to-source swaps that replace one character ability with another exported ability.
